author: Play On Tabletop
description:
This episode is sponsored by https://wingsmoothpainting.com/# From battle-ready miniatures to Golden Demon level show pieces they've got you covered! Want something wild? They can even 3D print custom models and kitbash your craziest ideas into reality! Wingsmooth Painting, you play, they paint!

We have an exciting today between Tycho and our guest Tomas. Tycho piloting the studio Black Legion army against Tomas and his Wraithhost, both beautifully painted by Wingsmooth Painting! In a battle of Zeal vs Survival, who will come out on top? Will Abbadon claim the souls of the Aeldari or will Eldrad be able to prevent tragedy?
